tasks.analysis: Climate change has become one of the most pressing current issues of our time, sparking global conversations, When discussing climate,it is often confused with weather. Climate specifically refers to long-term trends in temperature, humidity, wind , and precipitation that define typical conditions for a region—not just the daily forecast. While weather can shift dramatically from one day to the next, the climate of an area describes what is normal over decades.气候变化已成为当下最紧迫的全球性问题之一，引发了广泛的国际讨论。在谈论气候时，人们常常将它与天气混淆。气候具体指某一地区长期的温度、湿度、风力和降水趋势，决定了该区域的典型环境特征，而非单日天气预报。天气每日变化显著，而气候则代表一个地区长达数十年的常态环境。
